item.title: Ocala high school students protest ICE, Trump administration
item.description: Dozens of students at West Port High School gathered to protest the immigration enforcement policies of President Donald Trump and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) last week. Read more: Ocala high school students protest ICE, Trump administration

item.title: Clinelle Whitaker Bailey
item.description: Clinelle Bailey was an avid reader and enjoyed various genres. As a creative spirit, she had many hobbies to include ceramics, knitting, playing musical instruments, and quilting. Read more: Clinelle Whitaker Bailey

item.title: New 100-foot mural transforms Ocala business, marks first project for city grant program
item.description: A new work of public art has transformed the façade of a business along the NE 8th Avenue corridor, marking the successful completion of the first test pilot project for a new redevelopment mural grant program for east Ocala. Read more: New 100-foot mural transforms Ocala business, marks first project for city grant program

item.description: Phyllis Claybrook enjoyed going to flea markets, thrift stores, sewing, reading, and spending time with her fur babies. Read more: Phyllis J. Claybrook

item.title: Ocala women finish just shy of medals in first race at Winter Olympics
item.description: Although Ocala natives Brittany Bowe and Erin Jackson finished just shy of the podium during their first race at the Winter Olympics on Monday, both will have at least one more chance to claim gold at this year's games. Read more: Ocala women finish just shy of medals in first race at Winter Olympics

item.title: Kearsten Angel
item.description: Kearsten Angel played a mean game of Rook, held family close to her heart, and treasured her dear friends. She loved our great country and was passionate about her beliefs. Read more: Kearsten Angel

item.title: Truck strikes I-75 overpass, congesting traffic nearby to standstill
item.description: Another truck crashing into an overpass on I-75 has slowed traffic to a near standstill near an interchange in northwest Ocala on Monday. Read more: Truck strikes I-75 overpass, congesting traffic nearby to standstill

item.title: Red-shouldered hawk in SE Ocala tree
item.description: Check out this red-shouldered hawk spotted in a SE Ocala tree with his eyes on the prize. Thanks to Jennifer Corrigan for sharing! Read more: Red-shouldered hawk in SE Ocala tree

item.title: Neighbor accuses Ocala woman of stealing prescription medication
item.description: A 58-year-old Ocala woman is behind bars after she reportedly entered her neighbor’s home, grabbed a bottle of prescription medication, and stole more than a dozen tablets from it. Read more: Neighbor accuses Ocala woman of stealing prescription medication

item.title: We are happy about Walmart and Publix, but let’s finish construction on CR 484, first.
item.description: "As new members of the SummerGlen Golf Community, we are delighted that we’ll no longer have to travel to Cherry Wood Plaza or Belleview for full service grocery/pharmacy stores. Hooray! However, let’s get the road construction completed FIRST at SW CR 484 and 20th Ave at the SummerGlen entrance AND at 484 and I-75!
